newsitem.title: USA: Suffolk County, NY wants to cut budget by $106 mln.
newsitem.headline: Suffolk County, NY wants to cut budget by $106 mln.

text.p: The chairman of a legislative committee in Suffolk County, N.Y., on Wednesday proposed cutting the county executive's proposed capital spending plan by 41 percent, or $106 million.

Legislator Martin Haley of Rocky Point, in prepared remarks, said he was concerned county debt was spiraling out of control, threatening what he called the legislature's success in holding the line on property taxes in seven of the past nine years. Haley chairs the Legislative Personnel and Government Operations Committee.

The legislature's plan refocuses the capital budget for 1998 to 2000 by limiting funding to only what the government is required to do, Haley said, identifying these priorities as protecting public health while boosting the local economy.
